caption:
"저번에 적립 안 됐는데요"

이 말 들으면 난감하죠 😥

Take a Seat는 적립금을
정해둔 정책대로 쌓아요.
퍼센트를 한 번 정해두면
결제완료될 때 알아서 붙어요.

필요할 땐 직접 적립하거나
차감할 수도 있어요.

중요한 건 그다음이에요.
언제 얼마가 쌓이고 빠졌는지
고객마다 한 줄씩 남아요.
어느 예약에서 붙은 건지도
눌러서 바로 확인돼요.

기억을 더듬을 일이
없어지는 셈이에요.

프로필 링크에서
https://takeaseat.co.kr 확인하세요 🔗

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

"I didn't get my points last time."

That one is hard to answer from memory.

Take a Seat adds points by the rule you set.
Pick a percentage once and it lands on its
own when a payment is marked complete.
You can still add or subtract by hand
whenever a visit needs it.

What matters is what comes after. Every
change stays as its own line under that
customer — what happened, how much, and
the balance left after it. Lines that came
from a booking open that booking.

So the answer is on the screen instead of
in your memory.
